title: Hard bound: exact CPU fallback batching/microkernel

standalone_bound.decision: CPU fallback batching/microkernel alone cannot reach 10 tok/s. It can only be an intermediate SOTA candidate if implementation overhead is far below its saving.

combined_with_source_overlap_bound.interpretation: A 10 tok/s path without massive VRAM expansion requires near-perfect source/page overlap plus at least about half of the hot CPU fallback compute removed at low overhead.

decision.why: The touch split shows most of the 19.029s decode fallback is source/page exposure. After that is hidden, only 3.173s of hot compute remains; removing about 1.53s is enough for 10 tok/s only if source overlap overhead is near zero.
decision.next_step: Write a joint async source/page overlap plus exact CPU fallback batching hard-bound/design. Do not write runtime code until it proves enough overlap budget, cgroup page-cache safety, and correctness invariance.
